title: LookupResponse
description: Payload from GET /api/v1/lookup/{kind}/{value}: every row, in every stored zone snapshot, that holds the queried address or name. The value travels in the path (a CIDR's slash encoded as %2F or literal); nothing is read from a query string. Hits are never merged: the same address in another zone, or in another network of the same zone, is another hit.

query.description: The request as the collector read it.

value.description: Normalised: an address in canonical text form, a CIDR masked to its network, a MAC in lower-case colon form, a name trimmed of surrounding space.

hits.description: Best match first: by matchType in the order exact, containment, within, substring; among containment matches the longest stored prefix first; then by node, table and row name. Cut to `limit`.

node.description: The zone: the node whose snapshot holds the row.

table.description: The northbound table of the row.

rowUuid.description: The row's uuid in that zone's database.

rowName.description: The row's name column. Absent for NAT and Logical_Router_Static_Route, which have none.

construct.description: The logical switch or router the row belongs to: the switch that lists a port, the router that lists a port, NAT rule or static route, or the row itself when it is a switch or router. Absent for a load balancer (attached to many) and for a row nothing in the zone references.

network.description: The k8s.ovn.org/network identity: `default`, `cluster_udn_<name>` or `<namespace>_<name>`. Read from the row's external_ids (k8s.ovn.org/network, else the network of k8s.ovn.org/owner-controller), else from its construct, else `default`.

owner.description: The Kubernetes object the row's external_ids name; absent when they name none. `Pod` for a pod's switch port, the k8s.ovn.org/kind of a load balancer (`Service`), otherwise the row's k8s.ovn.org/owner-type with k8s.ovn.org/name as written.

namespace.description: Absent for a cluster-scoped owner and for an owner type whose name format the collector does not split.

matchedField.description: The field that matched, as the path of the value in the snapshot row. A row is one hit however many of its fields match; the best match type wins.

matchedValue.description: The matched value as stored: one address entry, one network, one VIP key, the name.

matchedValues.description: Every value of the matched field that matched at the same type, matchedValue first, present only when more than one did (a load balancer row with two VIPs on the queried address).

matchType.description: `exact`: the stored address, CIDR or name equals the query. `containment`: a stored CIDR contains the queried address or CIDR. `within`: the stored address or CIDR lies inside the queried CIDR (cidr lookups). `substring`: the stored name contains the queried text (name lookups).

snapshotGeneratedAt.description: When the zone's snapshot was collected: how old this answer is.

total.description: Every matching row, including the ones cut by `limit`.

limit.description: The most hits a response carries.

zones.description: The zone snapshots that were searched, by node name. A node missing here was not searched; `warnings` says why.

warnings.description: `ZONE_NOT_CACHED`: a node whose zone has no stored snapshot. `LOOKUP_CACHE_DISABLED`: the collector probes live but keeps no cache, so there is nothing to search.
